proposed_recipe.name: duck_crest_proto
proposed_recipe.rationale: Friendly duckling crest revision: the prior round was rejected because a source-side plume used Y<0. This version lists only Y>=0 side features for bilateral mirroring. A soft rounded crest tuft swept backward echoes the head shell curve, with one rounded side plume bump mirrored across Y=0 and a small top tuft. All smooth ellipsoids, no sharp or bulky silhouettes, matching Microduck's white/yellow identity in warm PLA yellow. Compact footprint (~18 x 14 mm pad, ~22 mm tall) on the frozen head-top datum, far forward of the camera face; camera FOV, adhesive retention, printability and mass remain open review items.

findings: CAD facts: part solids=1, bbox Z range 6.22..17.59 mm — the declared 18x14x2 mm base at Z=0..2 does not appear in the final body's bounds, so the visible crest sits ~6 mm above the datum with no contact; renders confirm a small floating yellow tuft above the head shell.

Perspective and +X close-up renders show the crest as a tiny detached two-lobed blob, not the intended swept-back crest with side plumes; the main 24x11x11 ellipsoid is not visible as a grounded form.
A disconnected solid implies the ellipsoid features intersect each other but not the base within the exported body; positive-volume connection to the foot is not demonstrated.
The crest overshoots forward: bbox max X = 5.3 mm vs center -2 mm suggests rotation swung the 24 mm ellipsoid; it stays behind the camera face in renders, so lens view is not obstructed.
Whole-robot motion check passed (min distance 23.7 mm, no violations) — no collision or obstruction of source geometry.
Yellow color (1.0, 0.78, 0.05) matches the source identity; shape language is smooth, rounded, friendly — no sharp or bulky silhouettes.
Overall silhouette is far smaller than the recipe digest implies (~13x17x11 mm built vs ~24 mm crest intended), reinforcing a partial/failed feature build.
Curvature fit, adhesive retention, printability and camera visibility under motion remain open, as declared.
review.reason: The built part (recipe 8bfd6894...) is a single small floating blob: feature bounds start at Z=6.22 mm with no overlap into the 2 mm base, so the accessory is visually and structurally disconnected from the datum. The intended three-lobe duckling crest did not materialize in the renders. Revise with shallower, wider features whose unrotated lowest Z is nonnegative and strictly below 2 mm with overlapping XY interiors, keeping the friendly yellow, smooth styling and clear camera face.

findings: Build proof accepted: single solid (solids=1), 16 bodies intact, motion passed with minimum distance 17.6 mm across all 31 sampled poses; no floating or disconnected lobes remain from the round-1 float defect.
Renders confirm the crest is fully seated on the head-top datum and connected; the previous Z=6.22 mm floating defect is resolved by the revised 0..2 mm lowest-Z overlap into the 18x14x2 mm pad.
Camera face stays clear in front and +X views; the crest sits rearward and does not obstruct the lens or head shell.
Silhouette is friendly and rounded (smooth ellipsoid tuft, no sharp fins), matching the white/yellow duckling identity; color RGB [1.0, 0.78, 0.05] blends with the existing yellow accents.

Weakness: in perspective and top views the built crest reads as a small single bump rather than a distinctive duck-crest motif; the side plumes are largely absorbed by the main lobe, so distinctiveness vs. the brief is marginal.
Extent (approx 22.9 x 17 x 13.2 mm), added mass 2.9 g and volume 2345 mm3 are compact and non-obstructive; within the sampled zone limits and not implausibly large.
Curvature fit to the curved head shell, adhesive retention, printability and real motion performance remain open, consistent with the prototype-study scope; interface_status is unverified.
review.reason: The revision is structurally sound, connected and non-obstructive, but the built renders show the crest reads as a single small bump with weak visual distinctiveness relative to the brief. One final revision will enlarge and sculpt the crest lobes (keeping friendly rounded forms, base contact and camera clearance) before selection.

selection.reason: Round 2 (recipe f20233a6...) is the built, reviewed, host-eligible candidate: single connected solid seated on the 18x14x2 mm pad (round-1 Z=6.22 mm floating defect resolved), motion passed with min distance 17.6 mm, camera face clear in all views, compact extent ~22.9x17x13.2 mm and 2.9 g added mass, friendly rounded yellow styling matching Microduck identity. Its noted weakness — reading as a modest bump rather than a strongly distinctive motif — is a soft stylistic shortfall, not a structural or safety defect, and further enlargement risks bulk the brief explicitly avoids. Round 1 must be rejected for its disconnected floating blob. Selecting round 2; curvature fit, adhesive retention, printability and real motion remain open as declared.
